headline_cluster.headline: מסמכים חושפים: הפרות שיטתיות של נהלים וסבל מיותר במחקרים שוליים

haaretz.note: paywalled (.premium) -- only subtitle + opening paragraph visible
extracted_claims: At least 300,000 animals used in experiments in Israel every year, most killed at the end
Documents (unnamed) revealed, after years of concealment, systematic procedural violations and unnecessary suffering in studies of 'marginal or negligible' scientific contribution
Tens of thousands of animals held in cages at any given moment across research universities, hospitals, private labs, government institutes, and the defense establishment

primary_source_search: partial -- Primary Council statistics collector (gov.il/he/departments/dynamiccollectors/animal-testing-unit-statistics) returned HTTP 403; the annual report files themselves were not read. Council/Health Ministry totals verified via secondary reporting: 286,328 (2010), 340,330 (2014), ~335,000 (2015), 507,018 (2016), 1,238,178 (2017; 886,852 fish, 97% of fish returned to habitat), 428,993 (2018), 402,412 (2019); 2022: >250,000 mice + >62,000 fish (no grand total published in coverage; 3,532 active permits). NGO Tnu Lahayot 'Animal Status Report 2025' (Maariv, 2026-01-12): >340,000 animals used, excl. defense establishment (classified), 'overwhelming majority' killed. Haaretz body re-fetched 2026-11-28: still paywalled; no incident count, no named document-holding body, no case studies visible. No other outlet coverage of the investigation found.

claims.claim_text: לפחות 300 אלף חיות משמשות בניסויים בישראל בכל שנה (At least 300,000 animals are used in experiments in Israel every year)
claims.note: Conservative floor, consistent with every reported year since 2014. Official totals exclude the defense establishment, so the true number is higher. Exact 2023-2025 Council totals not read (gov.il 403), so the latest year could not be pinned down.

claims.claim_text: ורובן מומתות בסופם (most are killed at the end)
claims.verified_figure: Tnu Lahayot 2025 report (compiled from government data): 'overwhelming majority' killed at end; 2017 Council report: 97% of fish (857k) returned to habitat
claims.note: Supported by NGO compilation and by species mix (mice ~70%+ of recent totals, routinely euthanized). Caveat: in fish-heavy years (2017) most animals by count were released, not killed, so the claim holds for recent years but not universally. No official per-year fate breakdown for recent years was read directly.

claims.claim_text: עשרות אלפי בעלי חיים מוחזקים בכלובים בכל רגע נתון (tens of thousands of animals held in cages at any given moment)
claims.verified_figure: none -- Council publishes annual use counts, not a standing-population census
claims.note: Plausible given ~300-400k annual use, but no official or NGO point-in-time housing figure was found. The list includes the defense establishment, whose data is classified and outside Council statistics.

claims.claim_text: מסמכים חושפים הפרות שיטתיות של נהלים וסבל מיותר במחקרים שתרומתם המדעית שולית או זניחה (documents reveal systematic procedural violations and unnecessary suffering in studies of marginal/negligible scientific value)
claims.verified_figure: none -- documents unnamed in the accessible text; no incident count; no NGO or other outlet publication of them found
claims.note: Core investigative claim, but not a data/analysis claim we can judge: paywall hides document provenance, incident counts and case studies. Re-audit if the full body becomes available.

note: No red-flag verdicts. The quantitative claims are conservative relative to official figures. The headline's substantive allegation is unverifiable from accessible material, which is a limit of what could be checked, not a finding against Haaretz.
